description.value: Barley Station Brew Pub is a craft microbrewery and full-service pub in the heart of Salmon Arm's Shuswap region, named after a replica of the town's historic train station. The brewery crafts its own rotating lineup of ales, lagers, pilsners, and seasonal beers using locally sourced ingredients, paired with an elevated pub menu featuring everything from fish and chips to Korean fusion tacos. A pet-friendly patio makes it a welcoming stop for cyclists touring the Shuswap corridor.

address.value: 20 Shuswap Street South, Salmon Arm, V1E 4H7
